# chezmoi-dotfiles

This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** (configs) + **ansible** (system
deps) dotfiles repo. This skill is the agent-facing map: how to drive it, and what
custom tooling exists that you wouldn't otherwise know about. It is rendered per-host
— the "What's enabled on THIS machine" section reflects what the user actually
selected at init.

## Orientation (read this first)

- **Repo root**: `chezmoi source-path` (no args) prints the source dir. Work there
  to edit: `cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`.
- **Source path of one file**: `chezmoi source-path ~/.config/foo/bar` → the
  managed source file for that target.
- **`docs/**` is NOT deployed to `$HOME`** (it's chezmoi-ignored). Read detail via
  `"$(chezmoi source-path)/docs/..."`. A *subset* is deployed to `~/.config/docs/`
  (e.g. keybindings, cli-tools) for runtime helpers.
- **Read the contract before editing**: `"$(chezmoi source-path)/CLAUDE.md"` holds
  Hard invariants and cross-file maintenance rules. Honor them.
- This host: profile `macos`, OS `darwin`/`arm64`, primary shell `zsh`.

## chezmoi essentials

```bash
chezmoi diff                 # preview changes (also: just chezmoi-diff)
chezmoi apply                # deploy + run scripts (also: cas, or just chezmoi-apply)
chezmoi status               # modified/added/removed targets
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc        # edit the SOURCE of a target
chezmoi add  ~/.config/x     # start managing an existing file
chezmoi re-add               # pull live edits back into source
chezmoi managed | grep foo   # is X managed?
chezmoi cat ~/.config/x      # render a target without applying
chezmoi data | jq            # the template data (ground truth for the toggles below)
```

- **`cas`** = `chezmoi apply` + reload hint; **`cau`** = update from remote then apply
  (defined in `dot_config/shell/99_chezmoi_reload.sh`).
- **`dotcfg`** = reconfigure the init prompts on an already-set-up machine
  (`dotcfg` for the TUI, `dotcfg --set installLlmTools=true --yes` for one toggle,
  `dotcfg --dry-run` to preview). Shell twin: `czcfg`.
- **Never `chezmoi add` a `modify_`/`create_` target** — it overwrites the script.
- Full command cheat-sheet: `docs/this_repo/cheatsheet.md`. Install-vs-upgrade is
  split: `chezmoi apply`/ansible is **install-only**; upgrades go through
  `just upgrade-*`.

## What's enabled on THIS machine

- **External editor** — init default `nvim` (independent of `enableVimMode`); `editorcfg status/list/use/reset/doctor` manages the local override. `EDITOR`/`VISUAL` name `dotfiles-editor`, which resolves and waits on each invocation. Micro is baseline devtools; code/cursor presets add `--wait`. See `docs/tools/editor.md`. Local `editor-choice` is not chezmoi-managed.

(Rendered from this host's selections. For live truth: `chezmoi data | jq`.)
- **Coding agents** — Claude Code, Pi (`pi`), Oh My Pi (`omp`), the `pia` Git-managed harness-combo manager, OpenCode, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Copilot (configs + CLIs). `pia doctor` checks the stack; `pia list --tree` / `pia use pi/base` select presets. The external checkout is `~/.local/share/pi-agents`; `08_pi_agents.sh` makes its canonical commands beat mise/Bun shadows, while runtime state and credentials stay elsewhere. See `docs/tools/pi-agents.md`, `docs/tools/agent-overlays.md`, `docs/tools/agent-skills.md`.
- **Python uv tools** — mlflow, marimo, jupyter, etc. (powers the `mlf` CLI). See `docs/this_repo/uv-bootstrap.md`.
- **Extra runtimes** — rust, bun, ruby via mise (+ cargo/gem tools). Node is always present.
- **LLM tools** — Ollama / LiteLLM / local models.
- **summarize** — `summarize <url|file>` turns a YouTube video, podcast, webpage, PDF or local media into a summary. Output defaults to 繁體中文 via the managed `~/.summarize/config.json` overlay. Wrappers in `32_summarize.sh`: `ytsum` (video, with timestamps), `sumq` (30-second triage), `suml` (long), `sumj` (JSON). `--cli claude|codex|gemini` reuses an already-authenticated agent instead of an API key. See `docs/tools/summarize.md`.
- **JS CLI tools** — standalone npm CLIs (e.g. readability-cli).
- **.NET tools** — .NET SDK (mise) + dotnet global tools.

| `sesh` fuzzy switch + `tmuxp` layouts | **Plugin** [herdr-plus](https://github.com/cloudmanic/herdr-plus) Projects + Quick Actions | Plugin + Projects templates |
| `tv` channel popups (`prefix+T/U/a`) | **Custom command panes** (`[[keys.command]] type="pane"`) | Key bindings + 2 herdr-aware channels |
| dev / lazygit / scratch launchers | **Custom command panes + popups** | Full-screen TUIs such as lazygit stay temporary panes; short-lived modal tasks use popups |

| Translation | **No tmux analog** | `prefix+t` opens the interactive `translate` TUI; `prefix+y` Quick Actions capture a pane for bilingual translation |
| File-path picker (`prefix+p`; extrakto `prefix+Tab` on tmux) | **Custom command pane + helper** | `prefix+p` → `path-pick.sh` — two-tier (exists-under-cwd first) → `x copy` |

| OSC133 copy-mode (`cpout`/`cpblock`) | tmux-specific | **Gap** — `cpcmd` (zsh history) still works |
| Per-window status glyphs + bookmarks ⭐📌 | Partial — `report-metadata --token` (per-pane metadata tokens, orthogonal to agent state) | **Review-pending flag** (`hmark`/`prefix+m` + `tv herdr-review` inbox); decorative status-bar glyphs still a gap (no format-string interpolation) |
| AI session-summary / agent-wakeup capture | `agent-wakeup` uses native `agent list/get/read` and stable agent-session IDs | **Shipped** — dual tmux/Herdr status, scheduling, preview, and safe send |

## Keybindings

Prefix is `ctrl+b` (same as tmux). Built-in actions can only be *rebound* (herdr's action set is fixed); everything else is a `[[keys.command]]` custom command. Custom commands receive `$HERDR_SOCKET_PATH`, `$HERDR_ACTIVE_PANE_ID`, `$HERDR_ACTIVE_PANE_CWD` and run from the focused pane's cwd.

> **Two families of herdr env vars.** The `HERDR_ACTIVE_PANE_*` vars above are injected **only** into `[[keys.command]]` invocations. Every shell *running inside a herdr pane* also gets an **ambient** set: `HERDR_ENV=1`, `HERDR_PANE_ID`, `HERDR_TAB_ID`, `HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID`, and `HERDR_SOCKET_PATH` (the current session's socket). Scripts use `HERDR_ENV` as the "am I inside herdr?" test and inherit `HERDR_SOCKET_PATH` to target the current session — that's what `hvibe`/`hcode` rely on.

> **Pane env is frozen at herdr-server start.** Unlike tmux (`update-environment`), herdr does **not** refresh `SSH_CONNECTION` / `DISPLAY` / `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` / `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` on a new client attach — every pane inherits whatever the daemon had when it first started. _**Agent (gpt-6-astra 2026-09-24 16:53:53Z)**_

**舊用法仍支援。** 新版主推整合工作台，但 1.14.0 的官方文件仍保留「agent 在左、Sidecar 在右」的用法。[並排流程](https://github.com/marcus/sidecar/blob/v1.14.0/website/docs/intro.md#recommended-workflow)、[新版推薦流程](https://github.com/marcus/sidecar/blob/v1.14.0/README.md#suggested-use)

| | 並排用法 | 新版主推的整合用法 |
|---|---|---|
| Agent 跑在哪 | Herdr／tmux 等外層 pane | Sidecar Workspaces 裡 |
| 誰管理畫面 | 外層 multiplexer | Sidecar 管理 terminal、diff、檔案、issue panes |
| 適合情境 | 保留現有 agent session，旁邊查看資料 | 集中管理 agents、worktrees、跨專案 sessions |
| td 的角色 | 任務、handoff、review | 同樣角色，直接整合進工作台 |

有兩個細節：

- **0.71.1 本來就有 Workspaces**；後續是逐步整合，不是新版才開始能執行 agent。[舊版 README](https://github.com/marcus/sidecar/blob/v0.71.1/README.md#workspaces)
- **tmux 沒被替換掉**：新版內建 terminal 的底層仍使用 tmux，要求 3.4+。[相容性文件](https://github.com/marcus/sidecar/blob/v1.14.0/docs/guides/active/tmux-compatibility.md)

已把版本演進、比較及操作方式補進既有的 [td + Sidecar 筆記](/Users/zhouhanru/.local/share/chezmoi/docs/tools/td_sidecar.md:29)，原本 td workflow／worktree 筆記也保留了。

`prefix + S` 已實作、套用並重新載入，維持你要的並排方式。本機升級後的 **1.14.0 已實測啟動與 zoom 成功**，設定檢查和文件建置也通過。
